workload: Synthetic one-stock book with 50000 resting orders and 520 valid records per measured batch; real tick model weights loaded but model timing reported separately.
time_representation: exchange seconds derived from Shanghai HHMMSScc wire time
age_maintenance: append-only expiry queue with lazy stale references and periodic prefix compaction
scope: Controlled component benchmark; excludes live socket, journal/SHM, routing, queue wait and strategy latency.
